rows.title: The contact address page's return controls, and 'Save and return' with 'Save and continue' while amending on the pages reached from another page
rows.detail: The contact address page is reached from the overview, so it keeps its two return controls, and their wording becomes 'Save and return to hub' and 'Cancel and return to hub'. The party pickers reached from 'Roles and addresses', the CPH number page and the permanent address page are reached from another page: outside an amendment each ends with its primary button alone, and while a notification is being amended each offers a primary button that saves the page and opens the review page and a secondary button that saves the page and carries on. None of those three pages offers a return control or a cancel link while a notification is being amended, and cancelling an amendment goes through the Amend bar to the cancel amendment confirmation page.
acceptanceCriteria: The contact address page's secondary save button reads 'Save and return to hub', and the link below the buttons reads 'Cancel and return to hub'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-027)

While a notification is being amended, each party picker reached from 'Roles and addresses', the CPH number page and the permanent address page ends with a primary 'Save and return' button that saves the page and opens the review page, and a secondary 'Save and continue' button that saves the page and goes on to the page it goes on to outside an amendment, and with no other control. (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/partials/design-release-2.1/journey-form-actions.html:7-10, 44-56 prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-074)

Outside an amendment, each party picker reached from 'Roles and addresses', the CPH number page and the permanent address page ends with the primary 'Save and continue' button alone. rows.title: Each set opens only notifications of its own category
rows.detail: Germinal products and live animals are sibling sets whose notifications sit in the one animals backend, so a notification can only be opened and changed in the set that owns it. Each set's entry guard reads the category recorded on the notification when its draft was created, and a notification with no recorded category is treated as live animals, so a draft stored before the germinal set existed still opens in live animals with no data migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a germinal products notification through a live-animals page shows the page not found page and changes nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031; repo:frontend routes-live-animals.js onPreHandler and flow/entry-guard.js repo-frontend-p1-092, repo-frontend-p1-134)

Opening a live-animals notification through a germinal products page shows the page not found page and changes nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031)

A notification stored with no category opens in the live-animals set, and opening it through a germinal products page shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)

rows.title: The germinal journey follows the live-animals step order, with no additional details, CPH number or permanent address step and 'Certified for' already answered
rows.detail: The germinal products set follows the same step order, opening run, return rules, shared journey buttons and status strip as the live-animals set, taken from copies of the live-animals pages once this programme has changed them, except that the additional details, CPH number and permanent address steps never apply: the opening run goes from identification, where it applies, straight to arrival details, 'Roles and addresses' carries no CPH number or permanent address row, and the overview carries no 'Additional details' task. The certified-for answer is set to 'Germinal products' when the draft is created, so nothing asks it and the review page shows it with no Change link. A germinal notification's status strip shows a GBN-AG reference, as a live-animals one does.
acceptanceCriteria: In a new germinal products notification's opening run, 'Save and continue' carries the trader through the pages in the same order as a live-animals notification's opening run, going from 'Identification details', where it applies, or otherwise from 'Commodity details', straight to 'Arrival details', and from the contact address page to the review page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-010, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-013; prototype:dr2-1-specs COVERAGE.md:167 prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-147)
